name: hf_ccpvtz_eri_l10
description: #121's split of #85's s-to-f case: hf_ccpvtz_eri's molecule and basis, with libcint's int2e for one representative shell quartet per angular-momentum class with la + lb + lc + ld = 10: (ff|fp) (ff|dd) (fd|fd). With hf_ccpvtz_eri (L <= 8) and its L = 9..12 siblings, all 55 classes of HF/cc-pVTZ, each file under the 512 KB hook.

provenance.command: PYTHONPATH=test uv run --group oracle python -m oracle.generate --regenerate hf_ccpvtz_eri_l10

density_recipe: hilbert: D[i][j] = 1/(i+j+1) -- symmetric positive definite, no RNG, reproducible bit-for-bit on any host
